statement.zh: 阿尔帕契亚 1933 年发掘出土哈拉夫圆屋（tholoi）与彩陶，见 Mallowan & Rose 1935（Iraq 2）。
statement.en: At Arpachiyah, the 1933 excavations yielded Halaf tholoi and painted pottery, as documented in Mallowan & Rose 1935 (Iraq 2).
